flows.title: Publish a form so responders can open it
steps: Open a form in Google Forms. Until a form is published, responders with the link cannot open it.
At the top right, click Publish.
To choose who may respond, click Manage, add those people to the form, and click Share.
Click Publish, or Publish and notify. Once it is published, the top right reads "Published."
Optional: under "General access," give access to anyone with the link or to target audiences, then click Done, then Publish.

flows.title: Share a form with responders
steps: Open a form in Google Forms.
Enter the names of the people or groups. To set what they may do, next to each name click the Down arrow, then Responder.
Optional: to end their access on a date, click Add expiration, pick the date in the calendar, and click Done.
